summary: v52co — Section D rebuild (UNSPSC multi-picker + KZ-gated legacy checklist) and Geography license-coverage overlay verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 14/14 (11 regression + 3 new business_categories round-trip). Frontend public registration portal: BD vendor correctly hides f-kz-licenses-block, surfaces f-categories-picker/input, returns 21 biogas and 24 solar UNSPSC rows, shows country-licenses-empty with the new 'No country-specific licenses are configured yet for BD' copy; switching back to KZ re-renders f-kz-licenses-block and country-licenses-block. Admin Masters → Geography shows the 4-tile geo-stats (Countries 250, With licenses configured 6, States 0, Cities 0) and all 6 geo-country-licensed-<CC> chips (IN 6 lic, KZ/AE/US/GB/SG 3 lic each). Country Licenses CRUD: added IN/test, saved, reloaded (chip present), removed, saved, reloaded (chip gone). Regression confirmed: /admin/vendors/new f-country now has 250 options and includes India (iteration 58 bug fixed).

integration_issues.issue: In Playwright, programmatic mouse click on button[data-testid^='f-categories-option-'] does NOT fire React onClick about ~100% of the time (chip never appears), but calling element.click() natively from page.evaluate DOES fire it and the chip renders + onChange persists correctly. Likely a focus-steal / synthetic-event quirk between the input blur and the button's onClick in UnspscMultiPicker; real users have been unaffected per visual flow. Worth a brief look (e.g. use onMouseDown instead of onClick on options, or preventDefault on mousedown of the button to avoid input blur race).

action_items: (Optional/low priority) In UnspscMultiPicker.jsx, swap option onClick for onMouseDown with preventDefault — eliminates the input-blur race that makes Playwright-driven clicks a no-op. Real-user clicks work today, so not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: SectionD.jsx: businessCategories useMemo wraps legacy strings as {code: v, title: v}; good, but UnspscMultiPicker then persists them back as {code, title} on next change — any legacy-string vendor who touches Section D will have their list silently rewritten. Acceptable since the model accepts List[Any].

UnspscMultiPicker option button has onClick AND the parent uses document mousedown to close on outside clicks. Button is inside rootRef so it is NOT treated as outside, but Playwright mouse flows blur the input first; consider onMouseDown to be click-reliability-insensitive.

GeographyTab license-coverage overlay fetch (mastersGeoApi.listCountryLicenses) is called on mount with no re-fetch when the Country Licenses tab mutates — admins who add a license then switch tabs still see the old count until page reload. Minor UX nit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of user-visible checks (10/10); 1 Playwright-only automation quirk documented separately

seed_data_creation: Transient: created 3 BD registration drafts via the public /api/v1/registrations endpoint (TEST_* prefixed emails) and left them in draft state. Also exercised Masters → Country Licenses add+remove on IN with code='test' (fully cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v52co acceptance criteria met. If you re-exercise Section D UNSPSC picker in Playwright, prefer dispatching the click via page.evaluate(() => el.click()) rather than Playwright's locator.click() — the latter is swallowed by what appears to be a blur-race in UnspscMultiPicker. The admin KZ-regression from iteration 58 (f-country dropdown had only 30 CIS countries) is now fixed: /admin/vendors/new shows 250 countries including India.
rca of the issue: Original user report: (1) Section D Business Categories picker was bound to the curated ~90-row /categories/public list, so Bangladesh vendors could not find biogas/solar; (2) Kazakhstan Licenses Held checklist always rendered. Fix validated: SectionD.jsx now wires UnspscMultiPicker to the full 158k UNSPSC codeset (same backend as Section C) and gates the KZ checklist on reg.country === 'KZ' OR an operating_regions office with country_code === 'KZ'. Backend models/registration.py broadened business_categories to List[Any] so {code,title} dicts persist. Verified via the exact user flow (public /register/resume) rather than the admin path.
